name: loom-desktop
description: Tauri bundler for the Loom macOS desktop app (task-local CLI; no global install)

scripts.dist: npm run build:app && rm -rf dist/Loom.app && mkdir -p dist && ditto "${CARGO_TARGET_DIR:-/tmp/loom-tauri-build}/release/bundle/macos/Loom.app" dist/Loom.app && codesign --verify --deep dist/Loom.app && echo "desktop/dist/Loom.app ready"
